name: dogfood-lean-orchestrator-specs-app
description: Dogfood app v2.14-2 — @kiwa-lab/lean で depth-5 pattern 5 lifecycle-orchestrator (transaction / session / cache / job / cli) の Lean 4 spec を生成、 kiwa の runtime testing (TS + vitest) と 静的形式検証 (Lean 4) を 同じ SSOT で駆動する仕様駆動開発 dogfood。

scripts.test: pnpm -F @kiwa-lab/core -F @kiwa-lab/lean build && node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('.vitest-dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.vitest.json && vitest run .vitest-dist/tests --environment node
